title: A Production AI Agent
summary: Synthesis. You are given a client brief: a support bot that must answer from a knowledge base, act on tools safely, run inside a bounded loop, and survive a flaky model API, graded against a rubric, not vibes.
objectives: A written design specification applying every prior module
A working implementation of the critical path (retrieval threshold + idempotent tool execution)
A diagnosis of a real reliability bug in code you didn't write

project.title: Production AI Agent Platform
project.brief: The major portfolio project. Combine structured outputs, token-aware context management, retrieval, idempotent tool calling, a bounded agent loop, retry/fallback reliability, and evaluation into one system with an architecture diagram, implementation, tests, and README.
